- [Español -- El ABC De Los Datos](downloads/abcs-of-data-spanish.pdf)

## Tools

*Can be integrated into CODAP*

- [Credibility Updater](https://ed-analytics.shinyapps.io/confidence-updater/) - Interactive tool for updating credibility assessments
- [CREDIBLE Local Data](https://ed-analytics.shinyapps.io/credible-local-data/) - Tool for working with local data in the CREDIBLE framework
